items.problem: A C# entry project depended on a C++ runtime component, but the C++/WinRT scope exclusion was not applied transitively.
items.evidence: source LinguisticServices.csproj lines 189-193 references RuntimeComponent.vcxproj; session-log.txt turns 19 and 34-36 show the agent inventing managed linguistic substitutes.
items.covered_at: SKILL.md frontmatter: '**C++/WinRT and VB UWP projects are out of scope**'
items.proposed_improvement: Make bootstrap inspect ProjectReference items and stop with an explicit prerequisite when a C# app has a non-C# dependency; state that silent omission or fabricated replacement is forbidden.
items.generalizes: C# UWP applications frequently consume native Windows Runtime components even though the entry project itself appears in scope.
